description: Pytest fixtures and setup code for integration testing of the notes_backend application, including environment setup, app import, and test client provisioning.

methods.name: None _set_required_env()
methods.description: Sets default environment variables necessary for testing, such as database connection info and JWT secrets.

methods.name: Any app()
methods.description: Imports and returns the FastAPI application instance, ensuring environment variables are set beforehand.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncClient] client(app: Any)
methods.description: Creates and yields an asynchronous HTTP client wired to the FastAPI app for testing purposes.

methods.name: str _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Helper method to sign up a user and retrieve their JWT access token.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] auth_headers(client: AsyncClient)
methods.description: Creates a test user and returns authorization headers containing a JWT token.

ctags.name: _signup_and_get_token
ctags.pattern: /^async def _signup_and_get_token(ac: AsyncClient, *, email: str, password: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: fastapi_app
ctags.pattern: /^    from src.api.main import app as fastapi_app  # noqa: WPS433 (import inside function)$/
